# Pixel Chess Clock

An offline, two player chess clock with five minutes per side. White starts; tap the active side after making a move to switch turns. Use the Pause button to stop or resume the clock. When the active player's time reaches zero, the clock displays **Flag!** and stops.

## Run locally

Open `index.html` in a modern browser. The app uses only local HTML, CSS, and JavaScript files and needs no server or network connection.
